default/31539.htm.text: Flame Blacksmith Vulcan: My name is Vulcan. I'm a wandering blacksmith, searching the world for stronger, more powerful flames. That's why folks call me the Flame Blacksmith. I hoped that I could obtain the ultimate flames in this Cauldron of the Gods! I must have them, and I won't leave here until…

Q00013_ParcelDelivery/31539-01.html.text: Vulcan, Blacksmith of the Flame: Did Fundin send you? A little late, but at least you didn't break it. Let me have it.

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31539-01.htm.text: Vulcan, Blacksmith of the Flame: Fire is the lifeblood of a blacksmith. I need a hotter fire to make this high quality weapon. I'm gathering flames from Forge of the Gods, can you help me?

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31539-02.htm.text: Vulcan, Blacksmith of the Flame: Fire is the lifeblood of a blacksmith. I need a hotter fire to make this high quality weapon. I'm gathering flames from Forge of the Gods. You don't want to get burned, do you? (This quest may only be undertaken by a charachter level 74 or above.)

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31539-04.html.text: Vulcan, Blacksmith of the Flame: Oh! You brought 1000 flames! What do you think? Do you want to trade the 1000 flames for my Weapon Recipe: Grade S? I just remembered that my younger brother, Rooney , also collects Flames in the Forge of the Gods. He's a wanderer, that boy! I've heard that he gives…

links.text: "I don't want to trade right now."

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31539-05.html.text: Vulcan, Blacksmith of the Flame: Hey, are you gathering Flames? Alas, you have not gotten 1000 of them yet. You do realize that you can get them from the Monsters located within the Forge of the Gods . If you so happen to bring me 1000 Flames , I'll give you something special in return. It might al…

links.text: "I want to continue to collect Flames."

Q00013_ParcelDelivery/31539-02.html.text: Vulcan, Blacksmith of the Flame: It's all here, thanks. Here's a token of my thanks.

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31539-03.htm.text: Vulcan, Blacksmith of the Flame: Very well! Let me ask you a favor! Bring me 1000 Flames from the monsters inside the Forge of the Gods . Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31539-06.html.text: Vulcan, Blacksmith of the Flame: Continue gathering flames from monsters in Forge of the Gods .

Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31539-07.html.text: Blacksmith of Flame Vulcan: Now. Here it is. What do you think? This S-grade weapon recipe is not easy to obtain. Q00617_GatherTheFlames/31539-08.html.text: Vulcan, Blacksmith of the Flame: Come back anytime if you change your mind, I'll be here.
